n: AirMedia® Receiver 3100 with Wi-Fi® Network Connectivity (AM-3100-WF-I)
d: AM-3100-WF-I AirMedia® Receiver 3100 with Wi-Fi® Network Connectivity, International

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: 100/1000 Mbps, auto-switching, autonegotiating, autodiscovery, full/half duplex, TCP/IP, UDP/IP, DHCP, SSL, TLS, SSH, SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol), IEEE 802.1x, Active Directory authentication, HTTPS web browser set

specs.label: Wi-Fi
specs.value: Dual-band 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax (2.4 GHz & 5 GHz); Up to 100 ft (30 m) range at 80 Mbps, subject to site‑specific conditions

specs.label: AirMedia
specs.value: Via Ethernet: IPv4, mDNS, TLS, AES; Via wireless access point: IEEE 802.11/b/g/n/ac/ax, 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz

specs.label: USB Host
specs.value: USB 2.0 for connecting a USB conferencing peripheral; USB 3.0 for connecting a USB conferencing peripheral

specs.label: USB Device
specs.value: USB 3.0 for computer console (installer setup and firmware update)

specs.label: HDMI Output
specs.value: HDCP 2.2, EDID, CEC; Supports management of HDCP and EDID

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: AirMedia; Supports simultaneous display of up to four sources with AirMedia Canvas when presenting using the AirMedia Applications, Apple Screen Mirroring or Chrome Extension. Displays up to three sources when presenting

specs.label: Maximum Input Resolutions
specs.value: AirMedia presentation: 1920x1080@30Hz (1080p30); AirMedia Connect Adapter: 3840x2160@30Hz (4K30); NOTE: All video inputs will be scaled to the selected HDMI output resolution.
